title: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
title_zh: GeoGR：面向高效三维VLM的空间-语义令牌压缩与分组路由

paragraphs.en: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models’ performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by 6.8 × 6.8\times and 6.1 × 6.1\times . These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR .

paragraphs.en: Enabling multimodal large language models to understand 3D scenes is an important step toward spatial intelligence [ hong2023threedllm ] . Due to the scarcity of 3D-language data compared with large-scale image-text corpora [ zhu2025llava3d , tang2025more ] , recent studies often represent 3D scenes as sequences of posed RGB or RGB-D views, allowing pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to transfer knowledge from 2D images and videos to 3D reasoning [ zheng2024video3dllm , zhu2025llava3d , chen2025integrating ] . However, converting a 3D scene into multiple 2D views inevitably introduces a large number of visual tokens. For example, Video-3D LLM uses 32 views per scene, yielding 6,272 visual tokens [ zheng2024video3dllm ] . Such long visual sequences make inference substantially more expensive, making efficiency a critical challenge for multi-view 3D VLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 使多模态大语言模型能够理解三维场景，是迈向空间智能的重要一步 [ hong2023threedllm ]。 由于与大规模图像-文本语料库相比，三维-语言数据十分稀缺 [ zhu2025llava3d , tang2025more ]，近期研究通常将三维场景表示为一系列带有特定姿态的 RGB 或 RGB-D 视图，从而让预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够将知识从二维图像和视频迁移到三维推理中 [ zheng2024video3dllm , zhu2025llava3d , chen2025integrating ]。 然而，将三维场景转换为多个二维视图不可避免地会引入大量视觉标记。 例如，Video-3D LLM 每个场景使用 32 个视图，从而产生 6,272 个视觉标记 [ zheng2024video3dllm ]。 如此长的视觉序列使得推理成本大幅上升，因此效率成为多视图三维 VLM 面临的关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: Multi-view 3D VLMs exhibit redundancy in both scene representations and visual computation. At the representation level, overlapping views repeatedly encode the same physical regions (Figure 1 (a)). While geometric correspondence allows for basic consolidation [ huang2025dtc ] , existing spatial pruning methods struggle to balance semantic saliency with scene coverage [ li2026segpruner , ling2026coverprune , li2026geometry ] . Strictly optimizing for salient objects discards the less prominent background regions essential for establishing 3D spatial context. At the computation level, dense inference processes all visual tokens at every LLM layer. Studies of image-based VLMs suggest that the contribution of visual computation varies across layers [ fan2025visipruner , fan2026what , wu2026hidrop ] , motivating us to examine how visual computation should be allocated across tokens and layers in multi-view 3D VLMs. Moreover, existing pruning strategies often make irreversible execution decisions. As we observe in 3D reasoning, a token’s relevance to the query shifts dynamically across layers (Figure 1 (b)). Permanently removing tokens with low relevance at one layer may therefore discard visual evidence needed for reasoning at later layers.
paragraphs.zh: 多视角 3D VLM 在场景表示和视觉计算方面都存在冗余。 在表示层面，重叠的视角会重复编码相同的物理区域（图 1 (a)）。 虽然几何对应关系可以实现基本的整合 [ huang2025dtc ]，但现有的空间剪枝方法难以在语义显著性与场景覆盖之间取得平衡 [ li2026segpruner , ling2026coverprune , li2026geometry ]。 严格针对显著对象进行优化会丢弃那些对于建立 3D 空间上下文至关重要的、不太突出的背景区域。 在计算层面，密集推理会在每一层 LLM 中处理所有视觉标记。 基于图像的 VLM 研究表明，视觉计算的贡献在不同层之间存在差异 [ fan2025visipruner , fan2026what , wu2026hidrop ]，这促使我们探究在多视角 3D VLM 中应如何分配不同标记和不同层的视觉计算资源。 此外，现有的剪枝策略通常会做出不可逆的执行决策。 正如我们在 3D 推理中观察到的那样，一个标记与查询的相关性在不同层之间会动态变化（图 1 (b)）。 因此，在某一层永久移除相关性较低的标记，可能会丢弃后续层进行推理所需的视觉证据。

paragraphs.en: To address these two forms of redundancy, we propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that compresses multi-view scene representations and selectively allocates visual computation within the LLM. At the projector level, between the vision encoder and the LLM [ wu2026data ] , we introduce GeoSemZip to construct a compact scene representation. GeoSemZip maps cross-view observations into a shared 3D coordinate system and consolidates them into voxel tokens. It retains voxel tokens with high encoder-attention saliency as dominant tokens and selects contextual anchors by sampling the remaining voxels along their 3D Morton order. These anchors complement the salient tokens by covering less salient scene regions. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into the contextual anchors according to feature similarity, retaining scene information that would otherwise be discarded. GeoSemZip thus shortens the visual sequence while preserving salient content and spatial coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这两种冗余形式，我们提出了 GeoGR——一个两阶段框架，该框架可压缩多视角场景表示，并在 LLM 内部选择性地分配视觉计算资源。 在投影器层面，即视觉编码器和 LLM [ wu2026data ] 之间，我们引入了 GeoSemZip 来构建紧凑的场景表示。 GeoSemZip 将跨视角的观察结果映射到一个共享的三维坐标系中，并将其整合为体素标记。 它会保留编码器注意力显著性高的体素标记作为主导标记，并通过沿其三维 Morton 顺序对剩余体素进行采样来选择上下文锚点。 这些锚点通过覆盖不太显著的场景区域来补充显著标记。 未选中的体素特征会根据特征相似性聚合到上下文锚点中，从而保留原本会被丢弃的场景信息。 因此，GeoSemZip 在保留显著内容和空间覆盖的同时，缩短了视觉序列的长度。

paragraphs.en: Within the LLM, we introduce GroupRoute to reduce visual computation through Late Entry, Early Exit, and Recoverable Group-wise Skipping (RGS). Training-free interventions that separately delay visual token entry and advance visual token exit suggest a layered pattern of visual computation in multi-view 3D VLMs: portions of shallow- and deep-layer processing can be omitted with limited changes to predictions. Using next-token KL divergence relative to full visual computation, we identify candidate window boundaries, then compare the candidates after compression-aware post-training to select the final window. Within this window, query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals (Section 3 ), motivating group reuse over short intervals with periodic reassessment. At anchor layers, RGS forms high- and low-priority groups using query-conditioned attention. High-priority tokens execute subsequent LLM layers, while low-priority tokens bypass them with their hidden states preserved. All visual tokens execute the next anchor layer and are rescored, allowing previously skipped tokens to rejoin the active group. Budget-constrained Anchor and Regrouping Search (BARS) selects anchor positions to minimize the risk of reusing groups under a computation budget.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LLM 中，我们引入了 GroupRoute，通过延迟进入、提前退出和可恢复的组级跳过（RGS）来减少视觉计算。 无需训练的干预方法分别延迟了视觉标记的进入并提前了视觉标记的退出，这表明多视角 3D VLM 中的视觉计算存在分层模式：浅层和深层处理的某些部分可以被省略，而对预测结果的影响有限。 通过计算与完整视觉计算相比的下一个标记 KL 散度，我们识别出候选窗口边界，然后在考虑压缩的后训练阶段对这些候选进行比较，以选择最终窗口。 在此窗口内，由查询条件决定的标记相关性在局部范围内保持稳定，但在更长的层间间隔中会发生变化（第 3 节），这促使我们在短间隔内重复使用分组，并定期重新评估。 在锚点层，RGS 利用由查询条件决定的注意力机制形成高优先级和低优先级分组。 高优先级标记执行后续的 LLM 层，而低优先级标记则跳过这些层，同时保留其隐藏状态。 所有视觉标记都会执行下一个锚点层并重新评分，这使得之前被跳过的标记能够重新加入活跃分组。 预算受限的锚点与重分组搜索（BARS）会选择锚点位置，以在计算预算限制下最小化重复使用分组的风险。

sents.zh: 在 LLM 中，我们引入了 GroupRoute，通过延迟进入、提前退出和可恢复的组级跳过（RGS）来减少视觉计算。

sents.en: Training-free interventions that separately delay visual token entry and advance visual token exit suggest a layered pattern of visual computation in multi-view 3D VLMs: portions of shallow- and deep-layer processing can be omitted with limited changes to predictions.
sents.zh: 无需训练的干预方法分别延迟了视觉标记的进入并提前了视觉标记的退出，这表明多视角 3D VLM 中的视觉计算存在分层模式：浅层和深层处理的某些部分可以被省略，而对预测结果的影响有限。

sents.en: Using next-token KL divergence relative to full visual computation, we identify candidate window boundaries, then compare the candidates after compression-aware post-training to select the final window.
sents.zh: 通过计算与完整视觉计算相比的下一个标记 KL 散度，我们识别出候选窗口边界，然后在考虑压缩的后训练阶段对这些候选进行比较，以选择最终窗口。

sents.en: Within this window, query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals (Section 3 ), motivating group reuse over short intervals with periodic reassessment.
sents.zh: 在此窗口内，由查询条件决定的标记相关性在局部范围内保持稳定，但在更长的层间间隔中会发生变化（第 3 节），这促使我们在短间隔内重复使用分组，并定期重新评估。

sents.en: At anchor layers, RGS forms high- and low-priority groups using query-conditioned attention.
sents.zh: 在锚点层，RGS 利用由查询条件决定的注意力机制形成高优先级和低优先级分组。

sents.en: High-priority tokens execute subsequent LLM layers, while low-priority tokens bypass them with their hidden states preserved.
sents.zh: 高优先级标记执行后续的 LLM 层，而低优先级标记则跳过这些层，同时保留其隐藏状态。

sents.en: All visual tokens execute the next anchor layer and are rescored, allowing previously skipped tokens to rejoin the active group.
sents.zh: 所有视觉标记都会执行下一个锚点层并重新评分，这使得之前被跳过的标记能够重新加入活跃分组。

sents.en: Budget-constrained Anchor and Regrouping Search (BARS) selects anchor positions to minimize the risk of reusing groups under a computation budget.
sents.zh: 预算受限的锚点与重分组搜索（BARS）会选择锚点位置，以在计算预算限制下最小化重复使用分组的风险。

paragraphs.en: To support compression-aware post-training, we use PRISM [ bi2026prism ] to select the least redundant 30% of samples from the original training pool, yielding a compact dataset of 67K samples. Using this post-training protocol, we evaluate GeoGR on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, without and with explicit 3D spatial encoding, respectively. Evaluation covers two question-answering benchmarks for LLaVA-OneVision and five benchmarks spanning question answering, visual grounding, and dense captioning for Video-3D LLM. At the projector level, GeoSemZip’s cross-view consolidation and residual aggregation preserve salient content and scene context under a limited token budget. At the LLM level, GroupRoute complements this representation-level compression with query-conditioned regrouping, improving performance retention over static projector-derived grouping while keeping temporarily skipped tokens available for later reactivation. Together, the two modules enable GeoGR to retain 95.2% and 96.8% of the respective dense post-trained models’ performance, with LLM prefill speedups of 6.8 × 6.8\times and 6.1 × 6.1\times and time-to-first-token (TTFT) speedups of 2.4 × 2.4\times and 2.3 × 2.3\times , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持感知压缩的后训练，我们使用 PRISM [ bi2026prism ] 从原始训练池中选出冗余性最低的 30% 样本，从而得到一个包含 67K 个样本的紧凑数据集。 我们采用这种后训练协议，分别评估了显式包含和不包含 3D 空间编码的 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 和 Video-3D LLM-7B 上的 GeoGR。 评估涵盖了 LLaVA-OneVision 的两个问答基准测试，以及 Video-3D LLM 的五个涵盖问答、视觉定位和密集标注的基准测试。 在投影器层面，GeoSemZip 的跨视图整合与残差聚合能够在有限的令牌预算下保留关键内容和场景上下文。 在 LLM 层面，GroupRoute 通过基于查询条件的重新分组来补充这种表示层压缩，相较于静态投影器派生的分组方式，提升了性能保留能力，同时使临时跳过的令牌可供后续重新激活使用。 这两个模块协同作用，使 GeoGR 能够分别保留相应密集后训练模型 95.2% 和 96.8% 的性能，同时将 LLM 预填充速度分别提升 6.8 × 6.8\times 和 6.1 × 6.1\times，首次令牌生成时间（TTFT）分别加快 2.4 × 2.4\times 和 2.3 × 2.3\times。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are as follows: (1) We propose GeoSemZip, a projector-level compression module that combines cross-view geometric consolidation with semantic saliency and spatial coverage. It aggregates unselected voxel features into contextual anchors to retain scene information under compression. (2) We identify effective visual computation windows in multi-view 3D VLMs and observe locally stable but evolving query-conditioned token relevance across layers. Guided by these findings, we propose GroupRoute, which combines Late Entry and Early Exit with Recoverable Group-wise Skipping. (3) We construct a compact 67K-sample dataset for compression-aware post-training of 3D VLMs and will release it publicly. (4) We propose GeoGR, a two-stage compression framework comprising GeoSemZip and GroupRoute that achieves a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B.

paragraphs.en: Token compression reduces visual sequence length within the vision encoder, at the projector between the encoder and the LLM, or within the LLM [ wu2026data ] . Methods select tokens by visual saliency [ shang2025llava ] or language-conditioned relevance [ xing2024pyramiddrop ] , merge similar tokens [ bolya2023tome ] , or combine selection with aggregation [ yang2025visionzip ] . For multi-view 3D inputs, geometric correspondence guides cross-view redundancy reduction, while spatial diversity promotes scene coverage. DTC [ huang2025dtc ] and ToSA [ huang2025tosa ] guide merging through voxel constraints and depth-derived spatial tokens, respectively. SeGPruner [ li2026segpruner ] and Geo3DPruner [ li2026geometry ] select geometrically diverse tokens, while Prune2Drive [ xiong2025prune2drive ] combines diversity-aware sampling with view-adaptive budgets. Within the LLM, Fast3D [ huang2025fast3d ] assigns sample-adaptive pruning budgets, and AdaToken-3D [ zhang2025adatoken3d ] schedules layer-wise token retention using spatial information flow. HiSC [ qu2026hisc ] combines spatial graph-based merging before the LLM with hierarchical cluster-based pruning within it. Our GeoSemZip combines salient token selection with spatial coverage and aggregates unselected voxel features into contextual anchors to retain additional scene information.
paragraphs.zh: 标记压缩可缩短视觉编码器内的视觉序列长度，也可在编码器和大型语言模型（LLM）之间的投影器中或 LLM 内部实现 [ wu2026data ]。 相关方法通过视觉显著性 [ shang2025llava ] 或语言条件相关性 [ xing2024pyramiddrop ] 选择标记，合并相似标记 [ bolya2023tome ]，或将选择与聚合相结合 [ yang2025visionzip ]。 对于多视角 3D 输入，几何对应关系可指导跨视角的冗余削减，而空间多样性则有助于提升场景覆盖度。 DTC [ huang2025dtc] 和 ToSA [ huang2025tosa] 分别通过体素约束和基于深度的空间标记来引导合并过程。 SeGPruner [ li2026segpruner] 和 Geo3DPruner [ li2026geometry] 会选择具有几何多样性的标记，而 Prune2Drive [ xiong2025prune2drive] 则将多样性感知采样与视角自适应预算相结合。 在 LLM 内部，Fast3D [ huang2025fast3d] 会分配随样本自适应的剪枝预算，而 AdaToken-3D [ zhang2025adatoken3d] 则利用空间信息流来规划各层的标记保留策略。 HiSC [ qu2026hisc] 将 LLM 之前的基于空间图的合并操作与 LLM 内部的基于层次聚类的剪枝操作相结合。 我们的 GeoSemZip 方法将显著标记的选择与空间覆盖性相结合，并将未选中的体素特征聚合为上下文锚点，以保留更多的场景信息。

paragraphs.en: Operation compression reduces computation along LLM width and depth [ wu2026data , hu2026wide ] . In image-based MLLMs, RedundancyLens [ li2025redundancylens ] and YOPO [ zhang2024treat ] exploit redundancy within attention and FFNs, with YOPO also pruning deep-layer visual computation. MWOP [ wang2026mwop ] further reduces computation within layers by pruning modality-interaction paths in attention heads and selecting FFN channels separately for visual and textual tokens while preserving the token sequence. Along depth, Skip-Vision [ zeng2025skip ] skips FFN updates for selected visual tokens, whereas ShortV [ yuan2025shortv ] freezes visual token updates in low-contribution layers. HiDrop [ wu2026hidrop ] combines late injection and early exit with progressive token pruning. ViCA [ liu2026vica ] bypasses visual token updates and provides text access to static visual features through sparse cross-attention. Our GroupRoute extends late entry and early exit to 3D VLMs with recoverable group-wise skipping. Query-conditioned token groups bypass complete LLM layers with their states preserved and are reassessed at subsequent anchor layers for reactivation.
paragraphs.zh: 操作压缩减少了 LLM 在宽度和深度上的计算量 [ wu2026data , hu2026wide ]。 在基于图像的 MLLM 中，RedundancyLens [ li2025redundancylens ] 和 YOPO [ zhang2024treat ] 利用了注意力和前馈网络（FFN）中的冗余信息，其中 YOPO 还剪枝了深层的视觉计算。 MWOP [ wang2026mwop ] 通过剪枝注意力头中的模态交互路径，并为视觉和文本标记分别选择 FFN 通道，同时保留标记序列，进一步减少了层内的计算量。 在深度方向上，Skip-Vision [ zeng2025skip ] 会跳过部分选定视觉标记的 FFN 更新，而 ShortV [ yuan2025shortv ] 则会在贡献度较低的层中冻结视觉标记的更新。 HiDrop [ wu2026hidrop ] 将晚期注入和早期退出与渐进式标记剪枝相结合。 ViCA [ liu2026vica ] 绕过了视觉标记的更新，并通过稀疏交叉注意力为静态视觉特征提供文本访问权限。 我们的 GroupRoute 将晚期进入和早期退出扩展到了三维视觉语言模型（3D VLM），并支持可恢复的分组跳过机制。 由查询条件控制的标记组会绕过完整的 LLM 层，同时保留其状态，并在后续的锚点层中重新评估以决定是否重新激活。

sents.en: Query-conditioned token groups bypass complete LLM layers with their states preserved and are reassessed at subsequent anchor layers for reactivation.
sents.zh: 由查询条件控制的标记组会绕过完整的 LLM 层，同时保留其状态，并在后续的锚点层中重新评估以决定是否重新激活。

paragraphs.en: Visual tokens play different roles across LLM layers, with vision–language interaction concentrated in the middle layers [ wu2026hidrop ] . This motivates late visual entry and early visual exit, which restrict visual computation to a middle-layer window (Section 4.3 ). Within this window, token rankings may still change as vision–language interaction proceeds, making it unclear whether a single-layer ranking provides a reliable basis for permanent token pruning. We therefore examine the cross-layer stability of attention-based visual token rankings, focusing on their consistency across nearby layers and whether initially low-ranked tokens become highly ranked at later layers.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉标记在 LLM 的不同层中扮演着不同的角色，而视觉与语言之间的交互主要集中在中间层 [ wu2026hidrop ]。 这促使了“晚期视觉输入、早期视觉输出”的策略，将视觉计算限制在中间层的窗口内（第 4.3 节）。 在此窗口内，随着视觉与语言交互的进行，标记的排名仍可能发生变化，因此尚不清楚单层的排名是否为永久性地修剪标记提供了可靠的基础。 因此，我们研究了基于注意力的视觉标记排名在不同层之间的稳定性，重点关注其相邻层之间的一致性，以及初始排名较低的标记是否会在后续层中变得排名靠前。

paragraphs.en: The two metrics on the right y-axis of Figure 2 quantify how initially low-ranked tokens enter the top half at later layers. paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , GeoGR combines projector-level and LLM-level compression for multi-view 3D VLMs. GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into compact tokens preserving salient content and spatial coverage. paragraphs.en: We collect 223K training examples from ScanRefer [ chen2020scanrefer ] , Multi3DRefer [ zhang2023multi3drefer ] , Scan2Cap [ chen2021scan2cap ] , ScanQA [ azuma2022scanqa ] , and SQA3D [ ma2023sqa3d ] . To reduce post-training cost, we construct a distilled dataset using PRISM [ bi2026prism ] , a training-free data selection method that estimates redundancy through the average correlation between mean-centered intrinsic visual representations. We retain the least redundant 30% of samples from each source, yielding a 67K-example post-training dataset, as summarized in Table 1 . To assess the subset’s effectiveness, we post-train dense models without any compression enabled. Relative to their counterparts post-trained on the full dataset, Video-3D LLM-7B and LLaVA-OneVision-7B retain 98.72% and 95.69% of performance, respectively. Detailed results for dense models post-trained on the full and distilled datasets are provided in Appendix D.1 . This dataset supports a unified compression-aware post-training protocol for adapting models to compression.

paragraphs.en: GeoSemZip constructs a compact scene representation preserving salient content and spatial coverage under a fixed token budget. It consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens, then divides the budget between salient dominant tokens and spatially distributed contextual anchors. Remaining voxel features are aggregated into the contextual anchors based on feature similarity.
paragraphs.zh: GeoSemZip 在固定令牌预算下构建紧凑的场景表示，同时保留关键内容和空间覆盖。 它将跨视角的观察结果整合为三维体素令牌，然后将预算分配给关键主导令牌和空间分布的上下文锚点。 剩余的体素特征会根据特征相似性聚合到上下文锚点中。

paragraphs.en: To retain information from voxels selected by neither branch, we aggregate their features into contextual anchors. Each unselected voxel is assigned to the anchor whose feature has the highest cosine similarity to its own. Each anchor then adds the mean feature of its assigned voxels as a residual, incorporating unselected content without increasing the token budget. Anchors with no assigned voxels and all dominant tokens remain unchanged. For serialization, each retained voxel inherits the index of its earliest contributing input token. paragraphs.zh: 为了保留未被任一分支选中的体素的信息，我们将它们的特征聚合为上下文锚点。 每个未选中的体素都会被分配给一个锚点，该锚点的特征与其自身的特征具有最高的余弦相似度。 随后，每个锚点都会将其所分配体素的平均特征作为残差添加进去，从而在不增加令牌预算的情况下纳入未选中的内容。 没有分配任何体素且所有令牌均为主导令牌的锚点将保持不变。 在序列化过程中，每个保留的体素都会继承其最早贡献的输入令牌的索引。 我们根据这些索引对保留的令牌进行排序，从而为 LLM 生成一个包含 M 个视觉令牌的有序序列。

paragraphs.en: Following HiDrop [ wu2026hidrop ] , we adapt late entry and early exit to multi-view 3D VLMs. Text tokens pass through all LLM layers, while visual tokens participate only within a window [ ℓ in , ℓ out ] [\ell_{\mathrm{in}},\ell_{\mathrm{out}}] . They enter at layer ℓ in \ell_{\mathrm{in}} with their original full-prompt position IDs and exit after layer ℓ out \ell_{\mathrm{out}} . Both boundaries use one-based indexing. To identify candidate boundaries, we independently vary the number of initial blocks skipped and the last block retaining visual tokens, measuring next-token KL divergence relative to full visual computation. As shown in Figure 4 , skipping the first K = 5 K=5 – 7 7 blocks yields the final consecutive low-mean-KL region before divergence increases. For early exit, KL drops sharply between retained blocks 21 and 22 and remains low from block 23 onward. These pre-adaptation measurements define candidate ranges, which we refine through compression-aware post-training. The resulting window for LLaVA-OneVision is [ 8 , 23 ] [8,23] , as evaluated in the window ablation study.
paragraphs.zh: 继 HiDrop [ wu2026hidrop ] 之后，我们将延迟输入和提前输出机制应用于多视角 3D VLM。 文本词元会经过所有 LLM 层，而视觉词元仅在窗口 [ ℓ in , ℓ out ] [\ell_{\mathrm{in}},\ell_{\mathrm{out}}] 内参与处理。 它们在层 ℓ in \ell_{\mathrm{in}} 处以其原始完整提示位置 ID 进入，并在层 ℓ out \ell_{\mathrm{out}} 之后退出。 两个边界均使用基于 1 的索引。 为识别候选边界，我们独立地变化跳过初始块的数量以及保留视觉词元的最后一个块，并测量与完整视觉计算相比的下一个词元 KL 散度。 如图 4 所示，跳过前 K = 5 K=5 – 7 7 个块可得到最终连续的 KL 均值较低的区域，之后散度开始上升。 对于提前输出，KL 散度在保留的块 21 和 22 之间急剧下降，并从块 23 开始保持较低水平。 这些预适应测量定义了候选范围，我们通过感知压缩的后训练进一步优化这些范围。 LLaVA-OneVision 的最终窗口为 [ 8 , 23 ] [8,23]，这是通过窗口消融研究评估得出的结果。

paragraphs.en: BARS selects anchor positions under a computation budget using layer-wise attention scores normalized over retained visual tokens. For a partition formed at anchor a a and reused at layer ℓ \ell , we quantify three risks: low-priority attention mass, migration from the low-priority to high-priority group, and mean normalized rank displacement. Risks are weighted by the remaining visual-computation depth, averaged within benchmarks, and then equally across benchmarks. For each feasible anchor count m m , dynamic programming finds the minimum-risk schedule 𝒜 m \mathcal{A}_{m} under a normalized visual token–layer budget and minimum anchor gap. Starting with 𝒜 1 \mathcal{A}_{1} , BARS considers increasing anchor counts, accepting a candidate only if it reduces both aggregate risk and each calibration subset’s risk by at least τ = 5 % \tau=5\% relative to the current schedule. With κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 , BARS selects anchors [ 9 , 13 ] [9,13] on both 3D VLMs. The schedule is fixed at inference, while token groups remain query-dependent. Appendix B.1 provides the risk definitions and procedure.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares GeoGR with representative 2D and 3D compression methods at approximately 10% retained LLM-side visual FLOPs. On LLaVA-OneVision, GeoGR retains 95.18% of the dense model’s performance, exceeding the strongest baseline, DTC, by 1.88 percentage points while requiring fewer FLOPs (8.65 vs. 9.36 TFLOPs). On Video-3D LLM, we evaluate five benchmarks covering QA, visual grounding, and dense captioning. GeoGR achieves the highest average performance retention of 96.80% at 9.09 TFLOPs. Compared with the strongest baseline, VisionZip † , it improves retention by 0.79 percentage points while reducing FLOPs by 3.2%. The results also suggest that compression effectiveness depends on how spatial information is incorporated. After compression-aware post-training, the 2D-native methods VisionZip and VisPruner retain 96.01% and 95.87% of performance on Video-3D LLM, compared with 88.34% and 92.26% on LLaVA-OneVision. Although these averages cover different benchmark sets, a plausible explanation is that Video-3D LLM embeds depth- and pose-derived 3D positional information into its visual representations, potentially benefiting even compressors designed for 2D inputs. LLaVA-OneVision lacks this explicit spatial encoding, but 3D compression methods can still use geometric information to guide token selection and aggregation. Such external guidance may be particularly valuable for preserving cross-view evidence on LLaVA-OneVision, consistent with the stronger results of 3D-native baselines on this model. GeoGR achieves strong performance retention on both 3D VLMs, supporting its applicability to models with different scene representations.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 3 , GeoGR speeds up LLM prefill by 6.8 × 6.8\times on LLaVA-OneVision and 6.1 × 6.1\times on Video-3D LLM, with TTFT speedups of 2.4 × 2.4\times and 2.3 × 2.3\times . It reduces the visual token KV cache from 359.7 MB to 36.6 and 38.5 MB, respectively. Practical acceleration depends on costs across the inference pipeline, as illustrated by the stage-wise bottleneck analysis in ViCoStream [ tan2026vicostream ] . In our setting, compression overhead is critical to realizing these gains. DTC spends over 2000 ms in the projector stage, outweighing its prefill savings, whereas GeoGR takes only 99.0 and 75.6 ms. These efficiency gains should also be considered alongside the performance retained after compression. SeGPruner is faster, but GeoGR retains more performance, especially when a 2D VLM is used for 3D scene understanding. On LLaVA-OneVision, GeoGR retains 95.2% of performance compared with 91.7% for SeGPruner, a gain of 3.5 percentage points for an additional 56.5 ms of TTFT. These results show a favorable trade-off between performance retention and inference efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 compares recoverable group-wise skipping with permanent pruning at a matched average token budget. We evaluate pruning at layer 9, layer 13, or both layers. With two anchors, tokens removed at layer 9 remain unavailable at layer 13. At each anchor, skipping selects half of the visual tokens for subsequent computation while preserving the hidden states of the others. At layer 13, all visual tokens are rescored, allowing previously skipped tokens to rejoin the active group. Pruning uses higher keep ratios to match the average number of active visual tokens per LLM layer. Single-anchor pruning retains 94.65% of performance at layer 9 and 95.03% at layer 13, while pruning at both anchors retains 94.73%. Skipping at layers 9 and 13 achieves the highest retention of 95.18%, outperforming all pruning configurations. These results support the observation in Section 3 that low token relevance can be temporary and that preserving tokens for later reactivation is beneficial.

paragraphs.en: We presented GeoGR, a two-stage compression framework for multi-view 3D VLMs that addresses redundancy in scene representations and visual computation. GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations while preserving salient content, spatial coverage, and information from unselected regions. Guided by effective visual computation windows and locally stable but evolving token relevance, GroupRoute combines Late Entry and Early Exit with Recoverable Group-wise Skipping, allowing temporarily inactive tokens to resume computation. A compact, selected dataset supports compression-aware post-training. Experiments demonstrate that GeoGR achieves a favorable performance–efficiency trade-off across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GeoGR，这是一种面向多视角 3D VLM 的两阶段压缩框架，旨在解决场景表示和视觉计算中的冗余问题。 GeoSemZip 在保留关键内容、空间覆盖以及未选中区域信息的同时，整合了跨视角的观察数据。 GroupRoute 以有效的视觉计算窗口和局部稳定但不断变化的标记相关性为指导，将延迟进入与提前退出机制同可恢复的分组跳过策略相结合，使暂时不活跃的标记能够恢复计算。 一个精简且经过筛选的数据集支持了面向压缩的后训练过程。 实验表明，GeoGR 在具有或不具有显式 3D 空间编码的多种 3D VLM 模型中，实现了性能与效率之间的良好平衡。

paragraphs.en: For both 3D VLMs, compression-aware post-training consists of projector adaptation followed by late-entry/early-exit adaptation. Each stage runs for one epoch with a global batch size of 16 and learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} . The second stage starts from the projector-adapted checkpoint. paragraphs.en: LLaVA-OneVision [ li2024llavaov ] provides a unified framework for single-image, multi-image, and video understanding. Its SigLIP visual encoder extracts patch-level visual features, which are further projected into the language embedding space via a two-layer MLP. Each sampled scene view is independently encoded, and the output visual tokens are concatenated with textual instructions to form the multimodal input sequence. Under our 32-view setting, each view yields a 14 × 14 14\times 14 pooled visual grid, producing 32 × 14 × 14 = 6,272 32\times 14\times 14=6{,}272 visual content tokens before compression. This 3D VLM takes only RGB-based visual features as input, while depth maps and camera calibration parameters are exclusively fed into our GeoSemZip module.
paragraphs.zh: LLaVA-OneVision [ li2024llavaov ] 提供了一个统一框架，用于单图像、多图像和视频的理解。 其 SigLIP 视觉编码器提取块级视觉特征，这些特征随后通过一个双层 MLP 投影到语言嵌入空间中。 每个采样的场景视图都会被独立编码，输出的视觉标记会与文本指令拼接，形成多模态输入序列。 在我们的 32 视图设置下，每个视图都会生成一个 14 × 14 的池化视觉网格，在压缩前会产生 32 × 14 × 14 = 6,272 个视觉内容标记。 这种三维 VLM 仅以基于 RGB 的视觉特征作为输入，而深度图和相机校准参数则完全输入到我们的 GeoSemZip 模块中。

paragraphs.en: Built upon LLaVA-Video-7B, Video-3D LLM [ zheng2024video3dllm ] explicitly integrates 3D positional information into multi-view visual representations. Specifically, depth maps, camera intrinsics, and camera poses project observations from different views into a unified world coordinate system. The obtained patch-level spatial coordinates are encoded and fused with visual features, endowing the model with robust spatial awareness. In addition to standard visual question answering, Video-3D LLM supports spatial reasoning tasks, including object-conditioned captioning and visual grounding. For object-conditioned captioning, the center coordinates of target objects are adopted to specify query instances. For visual grounding, the hidden representations of a dedicated grounding token are matched with object-level features to locate target objects.
paragraphs.zh: Video-3D LLM [ zheng2024video3dllm ] 在 LLaVA-Video-7B 的基础上构建，明确将三维位置信息整合到多视角视觉表示中。 具体而言，深度图、相机内参和相机姿态将不同视角的观察结果投影到一个统一的世界坐标系中。 所得到的块级空间坐标被编码并与视觉特征融合，使模型具备稳健的空间感知能力。 除了标准的视觉问答任务外，Video-3D LLM 还支持空间推理任务，包括基于对象的图像描述生成和视觉定位。 在基于对象的图像描述生成中，采用目标对象的中心坐标来指定查询实例。 在视觉定位中，专用定位标记的隐藏表示会与对象级特征进行匹配，以定位目标对象。

Questions require identifying objects, recognizing their attributes, and reasoning about their spatial relationships.We report CIDEr for generated-answer agreement and normalized exact match for answer correctness on the validation split.

paragraphs.en: SQA3D [ ma2023sqa3d ] adds a textual description of an agent’s situation, including its position and orientation, to a question about the surrounding scene. Answering requires interpreting the question from that situated perspective. The benchmark therefore tests whether the compressed representation preserves scene layout and spatial relations as well as object appearance. We evaluate the test split using normalized EM, with the situation description and question supplied together in the task prompt.
paragraphs.zh: SQA3D [ ma2023sqa3d ] 在关于周围场景的问题中，增加了对智能体情境的文本描述，包括其位置和朝向。 回答时需要从这一特定情境的视角来理解问题。 因此，该基准测试旨在检验压缩后的表示是否保留了场景布局、空间关系以及物体的外观。 我们在任务提示中同时提供情境描述和问题，并使用归一化 EM 指标对测试集进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Scan2Cap [ chen2021scan2cap ] evaluates dense captioning in 3D scenes, using object descriptions from ScanRefer. A caption must describe the localized object and may refer to its attributes and surrounding objects. For Video-3D, the target location is supplied through its coordinate-conditioned captioning prompt. We report BLEU-4 and CIDEr at a 3D IoU threshold of 0.5,which couples language quality with adequate object localization.
paragraphs.zh: Scan2Cap [ chen2021scan2cap ] 利用 ScanRefer 提供的物体描述，对三维场景中的密集描述生成任务进行评估。 一个描述必须对特定位置的物体进行描述，并且可以提及该物体的属性及其周围的物体。 对于 Video-3D 任务，目标位置通过基于坐标的描述提示提供。 我们在 0.5 的三维 IoU 阈值下报告 BLEU-4 和 CIDEr 分数，该阈值将语言质量与充分的物体定位能力相结合。

paragraphs.en: ScanRefer [ chen2020scanrefer ] asks a model to localize one object in a 3D scene from a natural-language referring expression. Descriptions use appearance and relational cues to distinguish the target from nearby objects. paragraphs.en: Multi3DRefer [ zhang2023multi3drefer ] extends language grounding to expressions that may refer to zero, one, or multiple objects. paragraphs.en: A voxel inherits a single score from the patches it contains, and the pooling rule decides whose score that is. Max pooling lets the best-scoring view of a region determine its rank, whereas mean pooling dilutes that view with the others, which matters because a region is often salient in only a few of the views that observe it. Table 14 confirms the effect: mean pooling costs 0.27 points of Avg. at the same token budget, so we keep max pooling.

paragraphs.en: The ratio ρ \rho partitions the budget between semantically salient dominant tokens and spatially distributed contextual anchors. paragraphs.en: We determine the two boundaries sequentially. First, we compare candidate late-entry layers without early exit. paragraphs.en: Both heatmaps show the strongest agreement near the diagonal, with agreement generally decreasing as the distance between layers increases. Adjacent layers thus tend to preserve the overall token ranking and share many of the same high-relevance tokens, whereas the composition of the top-200 set changes more substantially across distant layers. Taken together, these observations motivate recoverable group-wise skipping: low-priority visual tokens temporarily skip computation, and all visual tokens are regrouped at later anchors.

paragraphs.en: Table 18 compares projector-only, LLM-only, and two-stage compression on LLaVA-OneVision. GeoSemZip-only retains approximately 10% of projector tokens, which are processed by every decoder block. GroupRoute-only keeps all 6,272 projector tokens and uses GeoGR’s window [ 8 , 23 ] [8,23] , anchors [ 9 , 13 ] [9,13] , and keep ratio κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 . GeoGR combines a 30% projector budget with the same GroupRoute schedule. GeoGR retains 95.18% of dense performance with 638 active visual tokens per decoder block. Compressing only at the projector to a similar active-token count (628) lowers retention to 94.00%, a 1.18-point difference. GroupRoute-only retains 94.65% while processing 2,128 active tokens per block. These results support the effectiveness of combining spatial–semantic token compression before the LLM with query-conditioned group-wise skipping within the LLM.
